{'index': 0, 'translation': "Apple's next-generation M6 chip debuted last week in the new Mac mini, but several more products are set to upgrade to M6 soon. Below is the rumored launch timeline for Macs with the M6 chip, as well as the M6 iPad Pro."}

{'index': 1, 'translation': 'This fall: M6 MacBook Pro, M6 iMac'}

{'index': 2, 'translation': 'Apple is rumored to be launching two new M6 Macs this fall (likely in October or early November):'}

  • {'index': 3, 'translation': 'MacBook Pro'}
  • {'index': 4, 'translation': 'iMac'}

{'index': 5, 'translation': 'The MacBook Pro will only be the 14-inch base model. According to Mark Gurman, Apple will skip the M6 Pro and Max versions. Therefore, only the entry-level MacBook Pro will upgrade to M6, with the next Pro-tier chips being the M7 Pro and M7 Max in 2027.'}

{'index': 6, 'translation': "Apple's new iMac is not expected to change much beyond the M6 chip. The only other rumored upgrade is a new lineup of color options. However, jumping from M4 to M6 makes this new model still worth upgrading to."}

{'index': 7, 'translation': "It's worth noting that the rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro/Ultra is not on this list. It is also expected to launch soon, but will use the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips rather than M6."}

{'index': 8, 'translation': 'Early 2027: M6 MacBook Air, M6 iPad Pro'}

{'index': 9, 'translation': 'After this fall, the next batch of products rumored to upgrade to M6 are:'}

  • {'index': 10, 'translation': 'MacBook Air'}
  • {'index': 11, 'translation': 'iPad Pro'}

{'index': 12, 'translation': "The new MacBook Air with M6 is expected to launch in early 2027. It could arrive any time between February and April, but based on Apple's past practices, March is the safest bet."}

{'index': 13, 'translation': "Beyond the chip upgrade, there aren't many rumors about the new MacBook Air. Its design should remain the same as the M5 model. Reports suggest the OLED upgrade won't come until 2028 at the earliest, so the display will most likely stay the same as well."}

{'index': 14, 'translation': 'Apple last updated the iPad Pro in fall 2025, when it upgraded to the M5 chip. There are rumors of a refresh in spring 2027, which would follow its typical 18-month upgrade cycle.'}

{'index': 15, 'translation': "Beyond upgrading to the M6 chip, Apple's new iPad Pro is expected to add a vapor chamber for cooling. This design should help improve the sustained performance of this ultra-thin model."}

{'index': 16, 'translation': 'One potential benefit of M6 for the MacBook Air and iPad Pro is improved battery life. Apple says the 2-nanometer process used in M6 delivers "a major leap in performance and energy efficiency."'}

{'index': 17, 'translation': 'Are you planning to upgrade to any of these new M6 products? Why or why not? Feel free to share in the comments.'}
